content:
Will OpenKeyRing work as a replacement to OpenKeychain?

OpenKeyRing is a maintained hard fork of OpenKeychain (the original OpenPGP Android app, which has been in maintenance mode with no new features since around 2021). It focuses on OpenPGP and S/MIME key management for Android.

Status: Pre-alpha / early development. Things may break, and it is not recommended for full reliance yet. It is free, open-source, with no tracking, telemetry, or accounts. Source code is public at git.gay/owl/open-keyring. Direct APK downloads and releases are available; F-Droid and IzzyOnDroid support are planned. Minimum Android version is 5.0 (API 21).

The TB team have outlined their current position regarding encryption in the Github comment below.

https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/pull/11033#issuecomment-4771201103

We have had several discussions about encryption (GPG and S/MIME) in the app. This isn't in our roadmap for 2026, though might be something we add to 2027. For now we are prioritizing PRs that align with our 2026 roadmap.

You can add feature suggestions on Mozilla Connect where the community can vote on them. https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/idb-p/ideas/label-name/thunderbird%20android/tab/most-kudoed

Dies ist eine Einschränkung auf der Seite für die Standardeinstellungen beim Verfassen von E-Mails.

Eine Fehlerbehebung wurde bereits im Code implementiert und wird in der Version v23 enthalten sein, sobald diese zu gegebener Zeit in den App-Stores verfügbar ist.

In der Zwischenzeit können Sie die Signatur alternativ wie folgt bearbeiten:

Einstellungen > Kontoname > E-Mail-Versand > Identitäten verwalten Tippen Sie auf die Standardidentität und ändern Sie die Signatur.

Yes, this should be possible. The proposed flow makes sense: tapping the sender/profile icon would open a view showing all messages from that address, with a bottom action menu containing **Message**, **Mark all as read**, and **Delete all**. The **Delete all** action would then require confirmation before proceeding.

It would be a useful feature to bring over from BlueMail, especially for quickly managing all correspondence from a specific sender . .
